file_operations.description: Create a new Bhajan Library page with a hero banner using the generated image frontend/public/assets/generated/bhajan-library-banner.dim_1200x400.png. requirements.summary: Create Admin CMS page with password gate and three management tabs for Bhajan, Vrat Katha, and Holy Books
acceptanceCriteria: Admin CMS page at /admin-cms requires password entry to access
Three tabs: Bhajan Library, Vrat Katha, Holy Books
Admin can add new bhajan entries with audio file upload (base64)
Admin can add/edit/delete vrat katha entries with audio upload
Admin can add holy book chapters with audio upload
Uploaded audio stored as base64 Text in Motoko backend
CMS is separate from the existing AstrologerDashboard
Link to Admin CMS added in footer or a discreet admin navigation area

file_operations.description: Create a new Admin CMS page at route /admin-cms, distinct from the existing AstrologerDashboard. Implement a password gate form that requires the hardcoded password 'admin2024' before granting access (use local component state to track access). Once authenticated, display three tabs: (1) Bhajan Library Management – admin can add new bhajan entries (title, deity, artist, lyrics text, audio file upload converted to base64) and view/delete existing bhajan entries fetched via useBhajans(); (2) Vrat Katha Management – admin can add/edit/delete katha entries (title, festival name, story text, audio file upload as base64) using useVratKathas(), useAddVratKatha(), useUpdateVratKatha(), useDeleteVratKatha(); (3) Holy Books Management – admin can add new book chapters (bookTitle, chapterTitle, shloka text, audio file upload as base64, bookCategory) using useAddHolyBookEntry(), useDeleteHolyBookEntry(). Implement file input handlers that read audio files and convert them to base64 strings before submission. Display confirmation toasts on successful operations. Ensure all forms have proper validation.

Add an 'Admin CMS' link in the footer's admin section or a discreet location in the header (e.g., within a dropdown or secondary nav). Link to /admin-cms route. This link should be visible to all users but the page itself will be password-gated.

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks for new backend endpoints (bhajans, vrat kathas, holy books)
acceptanceCriteria: All new hooks exported from useQueries.ts
Query hooks fetch from backend actor using useActor pattern
Mutation hooks invalidate relevant query caches on success
Hooks follow identical patterns to existing ones in the file

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks following the existing patterns in the file: useBhajans() to fetch all bhajan entries via actor.getBhajans(); useVratKathas() to fetch all vrat katha entries via actor.getVratKathas(); useHolyBookEntries(bookTitle: string) to fetch holy book entries filtered by bookTitle via actor.getHolyBookEntries(bookTitle); useAddBhajan() mutation to call actor.addBhajan(...) and invalidate ['bhajans'] query cache on success; useUpdateBhajan() mutation to call actor.updateBhajan(...) and invalidate ['bhajans']; useDeleteBhajan() mutation to call actor.deleteBhajan(id) and invalidate ['bhajans']; useAddVratKatha() mutation to call actor.addVratKatha(...) and invalidate ['vratKathas']; useUpdateVratKatha() mutation to call actor.updateVratKatha(...) and invalidate ['vratKathas']; useDeleteVratKatha() mutation to call actor.deleteVratKatha(id) and invalidate ['vratKathas']; useAddHolyBookEntry() mutation to call actor.addHolyBookEntry(...) and invalidate ['holyBookEntries']; useDeleteHolyBookEntry() mutation to call actor.deleteHolyBookEntry(id) and invalidate ['holyBookEntries']. Ensure all hooks use the useActor pattern and properly handle loading/error states.

file_operations.description: Register four new routes in the TanStack Router configuration: /bhajan-library mapped to BhajanLibrary component, /vrat-katha mapped to VratKatha component, /holy-books mapped to HolyBooksAudio component, and /admin-cms mapped to AdminCMS component. Ensure all routes are wrapped in the shared Layout component and follow the same pattern as existing routes.

Each CTA should include an icon, title, brief description, and a link to the respective route (/bhajan-library, /vrat-katha, /holy-books). Use the existing card/button styling patterns from the Home page. Position these CTAs in a prominent section alongside existing feature highlights.
